message.reasoning_content: need to identify crimes based on facts: Li, an animal food inspection officer, forged 27 false documents "China animal health supervision prohibited production, operation animal and product documents" to help others obtain 50 diseased pigs harmless disposal state financial subsidy of 29,000 RMB. This is forging official documents, and fraud (骗取国家财政补助). Likely crimes: "伪造国家机关公文、证件、印章罪" (for forging official documents) and "诈骗罪" (defrauding state funds). Also possibly "职务侵占" but he is not using his position to appropriate funds directly; he helped others obtain subsidy fraudulently. So main crimes: "伪造国家机关公文、证件、印章罪" and "诈骗罪". In Chinese criminal law, forging official documents is "伪造国家机关公文、证件、印章罪". Fraud to obtain state subsidies is "诈骗罪". So answer: [罪名]伪造国家机关公文、证件、印章罪;诈骗罪<eoa>
